responsibility: Implements a random-access file device on top of the generic gm2 channel framework and FIO random-file operations. It allocates a device id, builds channels with RTgen/RTgenif plus RTfio callbacks, opens files in read or write mode as needed, tracks the current access direction in per-channel state, switches modes by reopening the underlying file while preserving position, supports FilePos queries and seeks through FIO position routines, and raises standardized device and RndFile exceptions when misuse or errno conditions occur.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the runtime implementation of the random-access file device, including channel/device setup, reopen-on-read/write-direction changes, FIO position handling, and exception raising. It differs from RndFile.def, which only declares the random-file interface, constants, and position operations.
